description: USGS EnergyVision is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "United States of America (USA)", published or maintained by the publisher of energy.usgs.gov. Maps of various factors relating to energy use in the USA, the most relevant of which is the USA and world-wide geological maps. To download, view the web map, then click on the dropdown box labelled MORE and scroll to the Download GIS data option. Coverage: United States of America (national); layers named in the list entry only. The list files it under "United States of America (USA)". The entry links to energy.usgs.gov. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
